name: git-advanced
description: Use advanced git: interactive rebase, cherry-pick, bisect, reflog, worktrees, submodules, recovery. Use for complex git operations.
checklist: Understand the operation before running it
History rewrites only on unshared branches
pitfalls: Rewriting shared history and breaking collaborators

name: git-history-rewrite
description: Safely rewrite git history: remove secrets/large files (filter-repo/BFG), squash, reorder. Use to purge sensitive data or clean history. Destructive - confirm first.
pitfalls: Assuming removal from history un-leaks a secret (rotate it)
No backup before a destructive rewrite

name: git-workflow-branching
description: Choose and run a branching strategy (trunk-based, GitFlow, GitHub flow) and clean PR hygiene. Use when setting team git workflow.

name: package-managers
description: Use package managers correctly (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/poetry/cargo/go/maven): lockfiles, reproducible installs, audits. Use for dependency install/management.
checklist: Exact versions for apps; ranges for libs
pitfalls: Mixing package managers in one repo
Installing globally when local is right

name: dependency-management
description: Manage dependencies over time: upgrades, pinning, deduplication, minimizing footprint, renovate/dependabot. Use for keeping deps healthy.
pitfalls: Adding a library for a one-liner

name: build-tool-make
description: Write correct Makefiles: targets, prerequisites, phony targets, variables, parallelism. Use for Makefile projects. Detect make first.

name: cmake-build-tool
description: Configure C/C++ builds with CMake: targets, properties, find_package, presets, cross-compilation. Use for CMakeLists.txt. Detect cmake first.
pitfalls: Global flags instead of target properties

name: gradle-build-tool
description: Configure Gradle builds (Groovy/Kotlin DSL): tasks, dependencies, caching, multi-project. Use for build.gradle(.kts). Detect gradle first.

name: maven-build-tool
description: Configure Maven builds: POM, lifecycle, plugins, dependency management, profiles. Use for pom.xml. Detect mvn first.

name: bazel-build-tool
description: Build large/polyglot monorepos with Bazel: BUILD files, hermeticity, remote cache. Use for Bazel projects. Detect bazel first.

name: monorepo-tools
description: Manage monorepos (Nx/Turborepo/pnpm workspaces/Lerna): task graphs, affected builds, caching, boundaries. Use for monorepo setups.

name: linting-formatting
description: Set up linters and formatters (ESLint/Prettier/ruff/black/gofmt/clippy) and enforce them in CI. Use to standardize code style/quality.
checklist: Lint rules agreed and not overly noisy
pitfalls: Bikeshedding style manually instead of automating
Disabling rules wholesale to pass CI

name: editorconfig
description: Standardize editor settings across a team with .editorconfig: indentation, line endings, charset. Use to prevent whitespace churn.
checklist: Line endings and charset set (LF, utf-8)
pitfalls: Mixed indentation without a shared config

name: pre-commit-hooks
description: Automate checks before commit/push with pre-commit/husky/lefthook: lint, format, secret scan, tests. Use to catch issues early.
pitfalls: Hooks not enforced in CI (easy to skip)

name: code-coverage
description: Measure and use code coverage meaningfully: line/branch coverage, gaps, avoiding coverage theater. Use when assessing test completeness.
pitfalls: Excluding hard code to inflate numbers

name: mutation-testing
description: Assess test quality with mutation testing (Stryker/mutmut/PIT): surviving mutants reveal weak tests. Use to validate test effectiveness.
pitfalls: High coverage with weak assertions (mutants survive)
Running on the whole repo (too slow)

name: static-analysis
description: Run static analysis/type checks/linters (mypy, tsc, clippy, staticcheck, SpotBugs) to catch bugs pre-runtime. Use to find defects without running code.
pitfalls: Running with lax settings that catch nothing

name: documentation-tools
description: Generate docs from code (Sphinx, JSDoc/TypeDoc, Doxygen, rustdoc, Docusaurus, MkDocs). Use to produce/maintain API docs.
checklist: Docs generated from source of truth

name: api-openapi
description: Design and use OpenAPI/Swagger specs: schema-first, validation, client/server codegen, docs. Use for REST API contracts.
checklist: Spec is the source of truth

name: api-testing-tools
description: Test and explore APIs with curl/httpie/Postman/Bruno/Hurl: requests, collections, assertions, CI. Use for manual/automated API testing.

name: regex-mastery
description: Write, debug and reason about regular expressions safely: anchors, groups, lookarounds, catastrophic backtracking. Use for pattern matching.

name: code-search
description: Search and navigate code efficiently: ripgrep, ast-grep, git grep, structural search, symbol lookup. Use to find code across a repo.
checklist: Use structural search for code patterns

name: ast-transformation
description: Transform code programmatically with ASTs/codemods (jscodeshift, ts-morph, Babel, libcst, comby). Use for large mechanical refactors.
checklist: Transform tested on a sample first
pitfalls: Regex hacks where an AST is needed

name: refactor-dead-code
description: Find and safely remove dead code, unused deps and duplication (knip, ts-prune, depcheck, vulture). Use to reduce cruft.
pitfalls: Removing code used via reflection/dynamic import

name: env-config-management
description: Manage configuration and env vars across environments: 12-factor, .env, validation at boot, no secrets in code. Use for app configuration.
checklist: Config from env; validated at startup
pitfalls: Different behavior from undocumented env vars

name: versioning-semver
description: Version software with SemVer: major/minor/patch, breaking-change discipline, pre-releases, deprecation. Use when releasing versions.

name: changelog-release
description: Automate changelogs and releases (Conventional Commits, changesets, semantic-release): notes, tags, artifacts. Use when cutting releases.

name: license-compliance
description: Manage open-source license compliance: SPDX, compatibility, attribution, copyleft awareness. Use before shipping/redistributing code.
pitfalls: Shipping GPL code in proprietary products unknowingly

name: cli-design
description: Design good command-line interfaces: argument parsing, help, exit codes, stdout/stderr, machine-readable output. Use when building CLIs.
checklist: Correct exit codes; errors to stderr
pitfalls: Errors on stdout mixing with data

name: tui-development
description: Build terminal UIs (Textual, Bubble Tea, Ink, ratatui, blessed): layout, input, rendering, resize. Use for interactive terminal apps.
pitfalls: No fallback when not a TTY
